description: The machine-readable, evidence-backed answer for one covered contract (the subject/v1 envelope): the full control graph (each Safe's signers, threshold, modules and guard, EIP-7702 delegates, and what is still unresolved), the complete state (every market, cap and queue), every pending change as a record with the transaction and log it rests on, the 20 most recent changes, and the value at stake. Use it when the user needs to verify or audit, not just read: the whole chain behind a role holder in one answer, what a pending change rests on, or the exact caps. Paid per call over x402; a call without a payment returns the price and where to buy, and charges nothing. get_control_state is the free summary.

address.description: The contract's address on Ethereum mainnet (0x and 40 hex digits), e.g. a Morpho vault's, a Compound v3 market's, a Safe's or a stablecoin's. Not a name: use search_covered_contracts to find an address.

sections.description: Optional: only these parts of the envelope (default all). The whole answer can exceed 50 KB.

name: get_control_evidence
title: The evidence-backed control answer (paid)
